asked: # Fable review pass of Opus-built foundation work Brett (Nov 1 2026): every headless build since Oct 31 ran on Opus because the launcher couldn't start Fable (fixed, axHub decision #111). His rule: **Opus or Fable only, never Sonnet; Fable for foundation work** (schemas, asset types, data models, kernel/engines, cross-app GUI behaviour). Plan he approved: **Fable REVIEWS first and only rebuilds what it flags.** Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md, _claude/THREADS.md, and the handoff `_claude/memory/handoff-2026-11-01.md` on axHub if available. ## Review these (each: read its report in _claude/builds/reports/, the schema/spec, core code, fixtures, tests) 1. One builds store (urgent-builds, merged 2a057cc4) + BUILDS spec / builds-core. 2. UI Review schema: ui-review-item@1 / ui-review-group@1 (review-schema) + shot-group@1. 3. help@1 + help mode engine (help-mode). 4. job-type@1 + agent jobs router (agent-jobs) and agent cap/queue (agent-cap). 5. session@1 + chat viewer store/ingesters (chat-viewer). 6. Agent swarm data model (agent-swarm; `agent-swarm-fable-rebuild` 0/7 already pending in profile breakroom — fold into it, don't duplicate). For each, judge against the AXF design rules (asset@1 envelope, namespaced ids, semver + migrations, open type registry, both validators web+Kotlin, conformance fixtures, tokens-only styling, typed placeholders, new types never need kernel changes, plugin-lifecycle) and long-term scalability. Verdict per item: **OK** / **fix** (small, do it now) / **rebuild** (needs a planned Fable build). ## Output - Do the small fixes in this branch (tests + lifecycle + theme + conformance checks green, migrations for any shape change, never break stored data). - For each **rebuild**: add an orchestrator build in the right profile, steps <= 30 min tagged Fable/Opus, and an entry on the Fable rebuilds list. Don't start them. - Add to `_claude/shared/rules/RULES.md` (merge carefully, claude-sync currently holds a conflict on it and decisions.md: keep BOTH sides' content): "Models: Opus or Fable only, never Sonnet. Fable for foundation work (schemas, asset types, data models, kernel/engines, cross-app GUI); Opus for the rest." - Report `_claude/builds/reports/fable-review.md`: table item | verdict | why | what changed or what's planned. THREADS row, STATUS. Commit on this branch, merge origin/main, push the branch. Do NOT push to main; Brett's session lands it with build_land. Never print secrets (do not cat secrets.env). End with a short phone-readable summary. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once.
